messages:
Priya (People Ops): Hi team — Casey just reached out about a recurring issue: they’re experiencing sensory overload in open meetings and want an adjustment to 1:1 cadence + a quiet break policy. They also flagged that past feedback has felt public and would like communication coaching for their manager. I can coordinate confidentially.
Carlos (Eng Manager): Thanks for the heads up, Priya. I wasn’t aware it had reached that level. @Casey I’m sorry — I want to support you. Can you share what helps (time of day, meeting length, format)?
Casey (IC): Appreciate it. Short answers: morning standups are ok, long design reviews trigger overload. Prefer 1:1s to be 30m max, agenda-first, and a 10min break mid-day after large meetings. Also would like written feedback vs public callouts.
Devon (Backend Eng): Echoing — asynchronous write-ups help me too. For oncall, we can swap or pair for any high-latency pager windows.
Carlos (Eng Manager): Got it. I can trim 1:1s and send agendas. I’d like coaching on giving feedback privately. Priya / Erin, can we arrange a short manager coaching session?
Priya (People Ops): Yes — Erin can run a 1-hr coaching session on feedback style + follow up notes. Erin, can you run this week?
Erin (HR Partner): I can. Suggested plan: (1) confidential intake with Casey, (2) propose temporary adjustments (30d) for 1:1 cadence, break window, and written-only corrective notes, (3) 1-hr coaching with Carlos on private feedback + communication style, (4) document accommodations in a private note. Is that ok?
Casey (IC): That sounds good. Timeline request: start tomorrow for the shorter 1:1s and the mid-day break. The rest can follow.
Carlos (Eng Manager): I’ll do the 30m 1:1s starting tomorrow at the same time. I’ll also stop calling out issues in public channels and move to DM/1:1s.
Erin (HR Partner): Great. Casey — I’ll send the intake form and confidentiality notice to you via DM. After intake I’ll set the 30-day accommodation record.
accom-bot: New accommodation intake created (ID: AC-200987). Assigned to Erin (HR Partner). :lock:
Priya (People Ops): For tracking: we should align with performance plan cadence. This is an accommodation request, not a performance discipline. Carlos — suggest we keep normal performance check-ins but avoid tying the accommodation to punitive measures.
Carlos (Eng Manager): Agreed. I’ll note that in my 1:1s.
Casey (IC): One more ask — on the days I need a quiet room, can we have a coverage note so I’m not put on ad-hoc meetings? Example schedule snippet:```coverage: {"date": "2026-07-15", "quiet_block": "13:00-15:00", "coverage_contact": "Devon"}```Not fancy but it works.
Devon (Backend Eng): I can cover that window. Casey DM me the dates and I’ll decline meetings or hold time.
Erin (HR Partner): Copy. After intake I’ll confirm the template we’ll use for quiet-block requests and post the private workflow for managers.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks all. Action items: Erin to run intake & coaching scheduling, Carlos to switch 1:1 format tomorrow, Devon to cover named quiet blocks, Casey to send dates, accom-bot logged intake. We’ll reconvene in 30 days to review. :thumbsup:
Carlos (Eng Manager): Thanks everyone — let me know if Casey needs anything else before tomorrow.
Casey (IC): Thank you. I appreciate the quick response and the confidentiality.
